title: Custom Case: Ship
description: A A tense, slow-burn atmosphere with a shocking final reveal. mystery involving a locked captain's log at The SS Meridian, mid-Atlantic. Four people remain under suspicion and the truth is not what it first appears.

suspects.name: Julian Marsh
suspects.motive: Owes a dangerous gambling debt that must be paid this week.
suspects.alibi: Says they were on the balcony taking a phone call.
suspects.secret: A lock-picking kit was found in their coat pocket.

suspects.name: James Oduya
suspects.motive: Was about to be exposed for a past professional error.
suspects.alibi: Says they were in the library reading alone.
suspects.secret: A note in their room reads: 'If they take it, I take it back.'

suspects.name: Saoirse Quinn
suspects.motive: Owes a dangerous gambling debt that must be paid this week.
suspects.alibi: Insists they were at their post the whole time.
suspects.secret: Their access log shows a 40-minute gap.

suspects.name: Dmitri Volkov
suspects.motive: Holds a secret grudge from a deal gone wrong years ago.
suspects.alibi: Says they were in their quarters on a video call.
suspects.secret: A note in their room reads: 'If they take it, I take it back.'

evidence.title: Wiped Footage
evidence.description: Two hours of security footage were manually deleted. A tense, slow-burn atmosphere with a shocking final reveal.

evidence.title: Video Call Record
evidence.description: A call record places a suspect well after the key time. A tense, slow-burn atmosphere with a shocking final reveal.

evidence.title: Heated Argument
evidence.description: A witness overheard a shouting match moments before the incident. A tense, slow-burn atmosphere with a shocking final reveal.

evidence.title: Handwritten Note
evidence.description: A cryptic handwritten line found in a suspect's quarters. A tense, slow-burn atmosphere with a shocking final reveal.

evidence.title: Solvent-Traced Coat
evidence.description: A lab coat carries traces of a solvent used to dissolve sensors. A tense, slow-burn atmosphere with a shocking final reveal.

evidence.title: Manually Tripped Fuse
evidence.description: The fuse box was switched off by hand, not by a storm. A tense, slow-burn atmosphere with a shocking final reveal.

evidence.title: Financial Letter
evidence.description: A letter revealing financial pressure and a reason to act. A tense, slow-burn atmosphere with a shocking final reveal.

hints: Pay attention to who had both physical access and the skill to bypass the security.
Two pieces of evidence point at the same suspect. Look for the access gap and the timeline mismatch.
The culprit is the Captain. They had Wiped Footage and could not fully account for their time.

_solution.motive: Owes a dangerous gambling debt that must be paid this week.
_solution.method: The Captain used their role and access to carry out the crime during a window they could not account for.
_solution.timeline: Before the incident - a heated exchange was overheard. During the incident - access was used and the sealed area was compromised. After - a suspicious cover-up action was taken.

innocent.s2: James Oduya had motive or proximity, but the evidence trail does not connect them to the sealed area.
innocent.s3: Saoirse Quinn had motive or proximity, but the evidence trail does not connect them to the sealed area.
innocent.s4: Dmitri Volkov had motive or proximity, but the evidence trail does not connect them to the sealed area.
